device_entry.name: 是德 DSO-X 数字示波器
tags: 瞬态信号采集与同步触发测量
device_entry.description: 这是一类台式数字存储示波器，用于观察和分析电压随时间变化的波形，并进行常见电学测量。它常用于电子电路调试、信号完整性检查、时序分析以及实验室中的通用波形测量。
device_entry.description_en: This is a family of bench digital storage oscilloscopes used to view and analyze voltage waveforms over time and perform common electrical measurements. It is commonly used for electronics debugging, signal integrity checks, timing analysis, and general waveform measurements in the laboratory.
